findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are excluded from the overall liability cap, meaning your exposure for indemnified claims is completely unlimited.
findings.suggested_change: The maximum aggregate liability of each Party for all claims arising out of or related to this Agreement, including indemnification obligations, shall not exceed $2,000,000.00.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I am reviewing the paperwork and would like to request a slight modification to the agreement before signing. - In the relevant clause, indemnification obligations are excluded from the overall liability cap, meaning exposure for indemnified claims is unlimited. I propose updating this so that the maximum aggregate liability of each party for all claims, including indemnification obligations, shall not exceed $2,000,000.00. Thank you for your consideration.
